candidate.bug_signature: editable pyproject backend without build_editable is accepted when setup.py/setup.cfg fallback or no build isolation is present
candidate.external_requirements: offline only; verifier creates local build backend/project fixtures and invokes pip from the staged source tree
candidate.repro_summary: Create a local editable project with pyproject.toml pointing to a custom backend that implements wheel metadata hooks but not build_editable, and include setup.py/setup.cfg files that previously masked the missing hook. pip install -e should fail consistently with and without --no-build-isolation.
candidate.bad_behavior: Editable installs can proceed past the PEP 660 capability check when setup.py/setup.cfg exists, and no-build-isolation skips the check entirely, producing confusing later behavior instead of a direct backend capability error.
candidate.expected_behavior: Every editable pyproject-backed install must verify that the selected build backend exposes build_editable and fail with a clear error if it does not, regardless of setup.py/setup.cfg presence or build isolation mode.
candidate.preserved_behavior: Backends that do implement build_editable still install in editable mode; non-editable installs using a backend without build_editable still work; legacy setup.py-only editable projects are not forced through PEP 660.
edge_cases: same failure contract when --no-build-isolation is used
setup.py and setup.cfg files must not bypass the backend hook check
backend object missing build_editable must fail without crashing
